episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When Sergeant Hayes is called to the cemetery, he makes a startling discovery. Six people have inexplicably returned from the dead and are in perfect health. How is this possible? Who are they and why are they back?

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After revisiting the cemetery, James confirms that the group have all risen from the dead and he confronts a mysterious and dangerous John Doe. Meanwhile Kate gets an unexpected surprise when she goes back home.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Vic is behaving strangely after his car accident. James relies on Maria to take him to Elishia's hideout, while Elishia uses Charlie to test the boundary around Yoorana, looking for a safe way out of town.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Vic finds Maria and convinces her to take him to the group, James spends an intimate night with Kate and Kirstie remembers how she died.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Sarah, James and Kate try to navigate their complex love triangle, grappling with a mixture of anger, grief and relief. Meanwhile, Charlie and Kirstie decide to seek answers about Charlie's past.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Elishia and Kate operate on Vic's leg, while James and John both increasingly grow suspicious of Elishia after Vic accused her of knowing more than she is letting on.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: James continues to help the Risen unravel the mystery of how and why they have returned, and a deadly new threat arrives in Yoorana.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: After questioning Elisha, James & Kate head to Noregard to get answers while John discovers his true name & history. Phil is on a mission, no-one is going to stand in his way.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: William and Elisha rekindle their love while James finally tells Sarah the truth, but all is not what it seems. At the Fitzgerald estate, Paddy is determined to right the wrongs of the past.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Realising that someone is out to kill them, Kirstie seeks to solve the mystery surrounding her death, while Paddy attempts to reconnect with the Fitzgeralds. Meanwhile William vows to bring Elishia back from the dead.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: With an unknown killer hunting them and the boundary continuing to shrink, tensions are running high as time looks to be running out for the Risen.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: James questions the unapologetic killer Phil and uncovers more of the disturbing truth about who and what he is. The Risen learn about Elishia's experiment and how they were returned to life.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Two newly Risen emerge from their graves as James struggles with Sarah's death. Meanwhile Kate, Kirstie and Charlie make plans to leave Yoorana.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Following an action-packed night in Melbourne, William discovers his true purpose. Meanwhile, Kate is en route to Adelaide when she realises she's been set up.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: With Chris still trying to protect the Risen, Kirstie deals with the possibility of an unwanted pregnancy as Charlie meets a love interest. Meanwhile, Phil returns to Yoorana with a new purpose.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Chi and Belle befriend a young Chinese boy as Kirstie and Charlie receive a tempting offer from Noregard. Meanwhile, Kate interrogates Phil about his true intentions as James and William forge ahead with their new plan.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As Chris' relationship with his brother is tested, Kate becomes increasingly suspicious of James and William. Meanwhile Kirstie tries to convince the Risen to take Sam's offer as Phil discovers the truth about James.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As catastrophic bushfires approach Yoorana, the Risen confront their fears of life and death. With Noregard's forces threatening them, the Risen must return to the cemetery with James and William before it's too late. (Final)
